_README: Every file under public/ must appear here, matched by exact path or by a glob. `npm run lint` fails on any file that does not. `ship: false` marks an asset that may not be published — the licence check run with --publish fails while any of those are still in the tree. This file exists because the project already lost a full voice-over to a licence nobody checked.

public/vo/six-wives.wav.source: Generated with ElevenLabs on the free plan
public/vo/six-wives.wav.note: Free-plan ElevenLabs grants no commercial licence, and it is not retroactively fixable. Must be regenerated on a paid tier with a GA model — Beta Services are carved out of the commercial licence on every paid tier. See docs/vo-licensing.md. Regenerating moves every word timing, so re-run `npm run align -- six-wives` after.

public/sfx/*.wav.source: Generated with ElevenLabs on the free plan
public/sfx/*.wav.note: Same finding as the voice-over. Regenerate on a paid tier with a GA model.

public/henry_vo_v3.mp3.source: Generated with ElevenLabs on the free plan
public/henry_vo_v3.mp3.note: Unreferenced by any short. Safe to delete outright — nothing imports it.

public/kit/pd/henry/*.png.source: Henry VIII, full length, after Hans Holbein the Younger, Walker Art Gallery — via Wikimedia Commons
public/kit/pd/henry/*.png.note: Cut into rig parts by tools/cut.py. The painter died in 1543; a faithful photograph of a two-dimensional public-domain work carries no new copyright.

public/kit/pd/anne/*.png.source: Anne of Cleves, Hans Holbein the Younger, Louvre — via Wikimedia Commons
public/kit/pd/anne/*.png.note: Cut into rig parts by tools/cut.py.

public/kit/pd/*.jpg.source: Tiled from the background of the Henry VIII painting above
public/kit/pd/*.jpg.note: Set dressing derived from the same public-domain scan.
